direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is both good and bad, as he does a good job building the world and setting the conflict, but does not do that good a job showing the significance of the stakes, as the pacing really drags this movie out into being boring; The direction on a microscale should be good because of the director-cast combo, but for some reason a lot of these performances feel stiff, as there isn't any chemistry among the cast; The storytelling is not the best, as the movie does not do a good job making you feel invested in the conflict, as the bad pacing and pretty bad dialogue really draw this movie out, which is a shame because on paper this movie looks like a story that really sounds interesting; While the tension is established decently well toward the end of the movie, they do not do a good job establishing the tension throughout the movie, as it just feels boring and a drag to get through, mainly because it moves very slowly in very tense moments

performance.comments: The most experienced actor of the bunch, and it shows, as he really just pulls from his experience to elevate his performance, despite what the material is giving him; Big jumpscare in the beginning of the movie

While her performance was very campy, it still was enjoyable and made the movie somewhat interesting; Her performance feels a little forced as it's like she's trying too hard, and even though it is what this character is supposed to represent, it just feels very unnatural
She's barely in this movie, as it just feels like she's wasted in this movie; she doesn't really do anything good or bad to make this performance feel memorable
Her accent really pissed me off throughout the movie because it just felt very unnatural; she does a decent job in more of the dramatic moments, but nothing in this movie really wowed me
Probably the best performance in the movie, mainly because he's the only one actually playing his nationality
I did enjoy his performance as he did show some depth and acting range, the problem is he's just not given that much to work with
I swear, like every movie I see him in, I just hate his performance, but I can't tell if it's because of him or the material

cast.comments: This really is the entire cast, and it does not have good chemistry at all as none of the conversations felt fluid or natural; while you can argue that this could be intentional because everyone is supposed to hate each other in this movie, they still don't even show that off effectively

story.comments: The concept is very interesting as it's based on true events and is genuinely crazy, they just waste the potential they had in its execution; the plot structure is very bloated as the exposition and rising action just feel like they drag for too long, while the climax and resolution are decently executed, it just felt like a huge chore to get there; character writing is one of the biggest issues for this movie because they don't do anything to make you really care for these characters, which is a big issue because this is a movie all about the cast of characters trying to survive on this island

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is very unnatural and feels pretty campy at times; the dialogue also feels pretty forced in the symbols they are trying to portray; the symbolism is there and very present throughout the movie, I just didn't really care for it because it is what you would expect from a movie like this; the foreshadowing is the only somewhat decent thing about the screenplay because the movie sets up a mystery in the beginning and you slowly see it unravel until the end

score.comments: Feels like Hans Zimmer's summer intern's project because it is barely there and is only used to build tension

cinematography.comments: One of the only good things about this movie is because it made this movie feel like a nature documentary, as it captured the beauty in such an ugly situation; Why Ron Howard continues to use his signature desaturated color palette, I will never know

editing.comments: Used well in conjunction with the cinematography as it helped capture the beauty in such an ugly situation, though some of the cuts really made the pacing feel a lot slower than the movie was

production_design.comments: One of the only positives for this movie is that the setting and scenery were beautiful in showing the wildlife of the Galapagos Islands

makeup.comments: Helps show how these characters are slowly losing themselves to the elements and situation; The contrast in look between Ana De Armas' character and the rest is symbolic in itself as it shows how she is painting on a facade to escape her reality

costumes.comments: Help show these characters are of the time

review.pacing: Pacing is the biggest issue for this movie because it just moves way too slowly, especially in most of the thrilling moments in the first half of the movie, and this just makes the movie feel boring when it is trying to grasp your attention
review.climax: Climax is interesting and somewhat entertaining, it is just not enough to redeem what you experienced in the first hour of the movie
review.tone: Tone is very much a survival thriller
review.overall: Overall, a pretty bad movie that had the potential to be something special as its director and cast present a premise that is really interesting, but the movie ultimately falls short because its pacing is too sloww, its character writing is just so bland, and its dialogue is just so unnatural that both create a boring experience that makes you want to escape this island
